description: Defines classes and functions for linking shader program resources, including uniforms, interface blocks, and buffer variables, during the program link stage in graphics rendering pipeline.

classes.name: UniformLinker
classes.description: Handles link-time checks and data population for uniforms in shader programs.

classes.name: InterfaceBlockLinker
classes.description: Abstract base class for managing interface block information during linking.

classes.name: UniformBlockLinker
classes.description: Manages uniform block interface data during program linking.

classes.name: ShaderStorageBlockLinker
classes.description: Handles shader storage block interface data during linking.

classes.name: AtomicCounterBufferLinker
classes.description: Links atomic counter buffers based on size mappings.

classes.name: ProgramLinkedResources
classes.description: Stores linked resource data such as uniforms, interface blocks, and buffers.

classes.name: ProgramLinkedResourcesLinker
classes.description: Facilitates linking of program resources, including interface blocks and buffers, using a custom encoder factory.

methods.name: link
methods.description: Performs the linking process for shader program resources.

methods.name: getResults
methods.description: Retrieves linked uniforms, unused uniforms, and uniform locations after linking.

methods.name: addShaderBlocks
methods.description: Adds shader stage interface blocks for linking.

methods.name: linkBlocks
methods.description: Links interface blocks using provided size and member info functions.

methods.name: linkResources
methods.description: Links program resources such as interface blocks and buffers.
